facts.text: The Bold Promise program covers 100% of tuition and mandatory fees for qualifying first-time freshmen for up to four academic years.

sources.title: UT San Antonio Bold Promise - Future Roadrunner
sources.quote: Qualifying first time incoming students will have their tuition and mandatory fees covered 100% for up to four academic years (eight consecutive fall/spring semesters) at our our academic colleges as long as students maintain eligibility.
